newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Shell urges acceleration in Argentine oil search.
newsitem.headline: Shell urges acceleration in Argentine oil search.

text.p: The Argentine exploration chief of Royal Dutch/Shell, David Greer said in an interview published Wednesday Argentina must speed up the search for new oil wells or risk losing its oil industry.
"If Argentina does not start exploring for crude...in 12 years oil activity will be finished," Greer told La Nacion newspaper.
Greer said Shell was confident of discovering oil at the Pejerrey well in the Colorado basin off the city of Mar del Plata, south of Buenos Aires.
Exploration operations will be completed next month at the site, the first well in a 15,000 square km area being explored by a consortium headed by Shell.
The company has a 51 percent share in the project, together with YPF with 29 percent and Italy's Agip with 20 percent.
"Geological studies by Shell allow us some optimism," said Greer.
